Fist Kyberos is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in the Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.
“
Hail the Archduke. His safety is my duty.
„
— Kyberos

Involvement

Act Three

Kyberos with several other Flaming Fists ( Fist Bella,  Fist Diallo,  Fist Earthdigger,  Fist Fernhollow,  Fist Klaas and  Fist Quickstitch) is standing watch in the Audience Hall of the Wyrm’s Rock Fortress at the ceremony of  Enver Gortash being ordained as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate. He is patrolling the southern nave of the hall approximately from X: -12 Y: 195 to X: 12 Y: 193.

If spoken with, Kyberos is not very talkative and expresses devotion to his duty, particularly to guarding Gortash in person.
